name: BACH_0318
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (97%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Conformal set holds only Normal; all 5 similar cases agree.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 97%, Benign 3% | Clear separation |
| Conformal set | {Normal} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.996 / 68th percentile | Typical input |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5 of 5 Normal | Unanimous |

## Tissue evidence
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 7, 8) · ↓ invasive · Strongest lower-invasive association in concept model [F2] · Validated
- **Normal lobules, two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 4, 10) · ↓ invasive · Lower-invasive association; spot check 0/20 [F3] · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 3, 9) · context · TILs present; descriptive only [F4] · Weak
- **Nuclear size** (regions 0, 3, 11) · context · Smaller nuclei than 90% of reference images [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions cuts the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007); not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules is Unreliable (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Small invasive foci sit in unsampled regions; cells were measured in only 3 of 12.
- Test set is small (132 images); calibration error CI reaches 0.18.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 11**: highest per-region invasive probability (3%); confirm benign.
2. **Region 3**: 25 nuclei labelled neoplastic, plus TILs; check for true atypia.
3. **Regions 5, 6**: gland-formation concept peaks here; confirm benign ducts, not in situ.
